tools.name: about_sftunes
tools.description: What SFtunes is, how x402 payment works, and the tapemaker revenue split. Free.

tools.name: list_tapes
tools.description: Index of all public SFtunes items: mixtapes (type 'tape') and public profiles' Top 10 lists (type 'top_ten'), each with id, title, tapemaker handle, track_count. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_tape
tools.description: One public SFtunes item by tape_id: a tape uuid, or top10-<handle> for a person's Top 10 + Side B. Ordered tracks with artist/title/liner note and canonical Spotify/Apple/YouTube links. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402; 80% goes to the person who curated it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_tapes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
